parsed.post: Kept the improvement (0.9891 -> 0.9828). It seems the lower LR (0.04) helped stabilize the DEPTH=6 model. Next, I'll test if a slightly higher WARMUP_RATIO (0.1) can further smooth the initial training phase without sacrificing convergence speed.
parsed.description: Testing if a longer warmup period (0.1) helps stabilization when using a more conservative learning rate (0.04) at DEPTH=6.
